**Fab Shift Log Summary:**

- Pressure drift in 3 chambers (1, 13, 25, 37), all within tolerance.
- Metrology queue behind (2, 14, 26, 38) minutes, no blockages.
- No significant issues with photoresist batches, CMP pads, defect densities, etch uniformity, litho overlay, furnace profiles, or wet bench chemistry.
- Brief, self-clearing vacuum alarms on implanters (4, 16, 28, 40).
- Handler jams on sorters (11, 23, 35), no wafer loss.
- Probe card cleanings (12, 24, 36) restored normal contact resistance.
- **Major Issue:** Killer defect cluster found on wafer W-24-0917 from LOT-7F2A-1183 due to cracked focus ring in etcher 7. Lot on hold.
